overall: The AG found the IT Subcommittee deliberated outside a posted meeting on Dec. 1, 2020, but that it cured the violation at its properly noticed, public Dec. 9 meeting, so no further remedial action was ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the IT Subcommittee met with the CAFO on Dec. 1, 2020, to discuss a multi-million-dollar procurement without posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the IT Subcommittee deliberated outside of a posted meeting on December 1, in violation of the Open Meeting Law, when a quorum of the IT Subcommittee discussed the status of, and concerns regarding, the Munis contract, a matter that was clearly within the IT Subcommittee’s jurisdiction.
